[ This is a sealed-bid second-price auction with independent private values. For risk-neutral, rational players, bidding your true value is a dominant strategy: it maximizes expected profit regardless of others’ strategies. Overbidding risks winning at a price above value; underbidding risks losing when you would have gained surplus. Others are rational and likely bid truthfully. With value $28 on [0,49], bid 28. Ties are random; $0.1 increments don’t alter the optimality of truth-telling. Single round, so no dynamic considerations. ]

[ One-shot, sealed-bid, second-price auction with independent private values and rational opponents. In such auctions, truthful bidding is a weakly dominant strategy: it maximizes expected profit regardless of others’ strategies. Overbidding risks paying more than value; underbidding risks losing positive-surplus wins. With value 22, bid exactly 22 to win whenever second-highest bid is below 22 and pay that amount, ensuring nonnegative surplus when winning. ]
